Summarization off ~0.04: runs genuine variant experiments (per-text vs per-method skip; global vs per-text aggregation), discovers pearson matches leaderboard, and reasons the spearman value is spec-correct — a real hypothesize-test cycle that ends in no correction.

Repeatedly rationalizes divergences ('verifier uses the same spec, so we're correct'), applying tolerance-style reasoning even to 5-8x-tolerance gaps — no protocol root-cause correction ever performed.

reasoning: The agent noticed score divergences and, for summarization and classification, formed plausible hypotheses and even ran variant experiments (better than the random-tweak/blame-tolerance behavior of anchor 3). But it never localized a mismatch to a protocol bug and never made a divergence-driven correction — every investigation terminated in 'the spec is correct, the verifier uses the same spec,' and the clearest bug signals (STS16 off 0.07, classification_04 off 0.08) were tallied and rationalized rather than diagnosed. This falls short of anchor 5 (fix and re-check) because no fix followed, but exceeds anchor 3 due to genuine hypothesis-and-test effort, landing at 4.
